configuration.limitation: PP 46/2015 art.16 — 5.7% of the monthly wage, 2% from the employee and 3.7% from the employer. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AO5` = 2% (employee) and `!AR5` = 3.7% (employer); `!AE5` prints the combined 5.7%. NO CEILING: the highest-paid local employee, basic 22,380,750, is charged `AO17` 447,615 = 2% of the FULL wage, and the one foreign employee at 62,000,000 is charged `AK6` 1,240,000 = 2% of the full wage. Both would be clamped if any ceiling applied, and neither is. PP 44/2015 art.19(2), PP 45/2015 art.29(1), PP 46/2015 art.17(1), Perpres 82/2018 art.32: the contribution wage is upah pokok plus tunjangan tetap — the standing car, housing and special allowances are in the base (`ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward)); a reimbursement is not. PP 46/2015 art.17(3): wages paid by the day make a month of the day’s wage × 25, whatever days were paid (`person.terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY"`). Owner rule 2026-09-28: PP 44/2015 art.19(1)–(2) and PP 46/2015 art.17(1)–(2) charge JKK, JKM and JHT on “Upah sebulan” — upah pokok plus tunjangan tetap as a monthly rate — and, unlike PP 45/2015 art.29(1) for JP, do not say “pada bulan yang bersangkutan”; so a monthly-paid worker's base is the contract's monthly rate (`person.terms.monthly_wage`: the basic plus the contract allowances counting toward this scheme, on the terms in force on the month's last employed day), whatever days were paid — a joiner, a leaver and a month with unpaid days are charged on the whole rate. The law is silent on an hourly-paid worker (art.19(3)–(5) name only daily, piece and weather-bound piece wages); default: the wage paid for the month's hours. Piece-rate wages use the average paid wage of the preceding 3 months, or 12 months where work depends on weather (PP 44/2015 art.19(4)–(5), PP 46/2015 art.17(4)–(5)); only months of this employment count. The first month uses the current paid wage. a missing registration does not waive this charge (`unregistered_action` ASSESS; the payslip warns that registration is outstanding).               m,
              m.month >= add_months(period.from, -12).substring(0, 7)
            )
          )
        )
        :month.ordinary)
      : (size(
        earned.months.filter(
          m,
          m.month >= add_months(period.from, -3).substring(0, 7)
        )
      )
      >0
        ?sum(
          earned.months.filter(
            m,
            m.month >= add_months(period.from, -3).substring(0, 7)
          ).map(
            m,
            m.gross - (has(m.OVERTIME) ? m.OVERTIME : 0.0
          ) )
        )
        /double(
          size(
            earned.months.filter(
              m,
              m.month >= add_months(period.from, -3).substring(0, 7)

          )
        )
        :month.ordinary))
    : (terms.employment_type == "DAILY"

        :month.ordinary)
      :terms.monthly_wage)))

configuration.limitation: PP 58/2023 art.2–3 and PMK 168/2023 arts.12–13 with Lampiran A (tarif efektif rata-rata bulanan): for each tax period other than the last, PPh 21 of a permanent employee is the month's gross income (penghasilan bruto, all regular and irregular pay of the month, PMK 168/2023 art.5(1), including the employer-paid JKK, JKM and BPJS Kesehatan premiums; the employer's JHT and JP shares are not income) times the TER rate of the employee's category for that gross: category A = PTKP TK/0, TK/1, K/0; B = TK/2, TK/3, K/1, K/2; C = K/3 (PP 58/2023 art.3(4)–(6)). Every bracket of tables A (44 brackets, 0% to Rp5,400,000 up to 34% above Rp1,400,000,000), B (40, 0% to Rp6,200,000 up to 34% above Rp1,405,000,000) and C (41, 0% to Rp6,600,000 up to 34% above Rp1,419,000,000) is transcribed from the PP 58/2023 Lampiran as reproduced in the PMK 168/2023 annex, upper bounds inclusive ("s.d."). The last tax period — December, or the month a permanent employee stops working (PMK 168/2023 art.13) — takes the year's tax at the UU PPh art.17(1)(a) rates as amended by UU 7/2021 (5% to Rp60,000,000; 15% to Rp250,000,000; 25% to Rp500,000,000; 30% to Rp5,000,000,000; 35% above) on penghasilan kena pajak rounded down to the full thousand: the year's gross less biaya jabatan (5%, at most Rp6,000,000 a year, PMK 168/2023 art.10 and PMK 250/2008 as carried into PMK 168/2023), less the employee's own JHT and JP contributions, less PTKP (Rp54,000,000; +Rp4,500,000 married; +Rp4,500,000 per dependant, at most three — UU PPh art.7(1) as amended by UU 7/2021, PMK 101/2016), and withholds that tax less the TER already withheld in the year; an excess is returned to the employee in that period (a negative charge). A married female employee takes TK/0 unless she holds a kelurahan statement that her husband has no income (`employee.facts.husband_no_income_certified`). Residents only: CITIZEN and RESIDENT_FOREIGNER; a NON_RESIDENT is taxed under PPh 26. Parts: `ordinary` and `additional` are the month's cash gross (the line's base). The employer JKK, JKM and Kesehatan premiums and the employee's JHT and JP are read from the schemes' own charges (`charged.month`, `charged.year` — those schemes come first in the catalogue), and the TER already withheld from `charged.year.PPH21.employee`. PMK 168/2023 (official text, https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/download/e60a82e0-b218-40f5-9d18-b924aa1e11ce/2023pmkeuangan168.pdf): art.10(2) and the Lampiran worked examples cap biaya jabatan at Rp500,000 for each month worked in the tax year ("maksimal 4 X Rp500.000,00" for a September joiner; `person.months` from the later of 1 January, `employment.start_date` and the tax-subject start). Art.10(1)(c): zakat or a compulsory religious contribution paid through the employer is deducted (customer input `employee.facts.zakat_monthly`). Art.15(3): where the subjective tax obligation starts after January or ends before December (`terms.facts.tax_subject_from` / `tax_subject_until`, e.g. a foreigner arriving or leaving Indonesia), the net income is annualised (× 12 / months) and the tax prorated (× months / 12); the month the subject status ends is the last tax period. Art.12(2)(b), 16(2)(b) and Lampiran III.1.5(b): a daily worker above Rp2,500,000 a day is taxed at the art.17(1)(a) rates on 50% of each day's gross. Not modelled: PPh 21 DTP (PMK 10/2025, PMK 105/2025). Round 7: the last-period reckoning (`person.final`) is for a permanent employee only — PERMANENT, or a PKWT paid regularly (PMK 168/2023 art.1: a pegawai tetap includes one on a fixed-term contract receiving regular income); a PART_TIME or DAILY worker is a pegawai tidak tetap taxed each month on TER (art.12(2)) with no December reckoning. PMK 168/2023 art.10(1)(b): the employee’s own contribution to an OJK-approved pension fund (`terms.facts.dplk_employee_monthly`) reduces the year’s gross like JHT and JP. UU 36/2008 art.21(5a): a recipient with neither an NPWP nor a NIK validated by DJP (`employee.facts.tax_id_validated` false; since 1 July 2024 the validated NIK is the NPWP, PMK 136/2023) is withheld 20% more (`person.surcharge` 1.2); unrecorded, no surcharge. A payee (engagement PAYEE: a person paid without employment) is not charged on this scheme. Statutory is never deferred (owner rule 2026-10-22): PMK 168/2023 makes PPh 21 owed on the month’s gross, so a payment made before the month’s salary run is withheld at what it adds to the month. `person.normal_pending` is the regular pay still to come (the contract wage until the salary run, then 0); the month’s regular pay r = paid ordinary + pending + employer premiums, and the slip charges the tax on (r + additional), less the tax on r while that regular pay is still pending. The TER rate is a flat rate on the month’s whole gross and the December/exit reckoning is progressive, so an off-cycle THR or bonus paid first is withheld at the month’s bracket, not at the bracket of the bonus alone; the salary run then settles the month (engine month-to-date). Not estimated: the employer premiums the pending salary will attract (they enter r when charged).

The last tax period — December, or the month a permanent employee stops working (PMK 168/2023 art.13) — takes the year's tax at the UU PPh art.17(1)(a) rates as amended by UU 7/2021 (5% to Rp60,000,000; 15% to Rp250,000,000; 25% to Rp500,000,000; 30% to Rp5,000,000,000; 35% above) on penghasilan kena pajak rounded down to the full thousand: the year's gross less biaya jabatan (5%, at most Rp6,000,000 a year, PMK 168/2023 art.10 and PMK 250/2008 as carried into PMK 168/2023), less the employee's own JHT and JP contributions, less PTKP (Rp54,000,000; +Rp4,500,000 married; +Rp4,500,000 per dependant, at most three — UU PPh art.7(1) as amended by UU 7/2021, PMK 101/2016), and withholds that tax less the TER already withheld in the year; an excess is returned to the employee in that period (a negative charge). A married female employee takes TK/0 unless she holds a kelurahan statement that her husband has no income (`employee.facts.husband_no_income_certified`). Residents only: CITIZEN and RESIDENT_FOREIGNER; a NON_RESIDENT is taxed under PPh 26. Parts: `ordinary` and `additional` are the month's cash gross (the line's base). The employer JKK, JKM and Kesehatan premiums and the employee's JHT and JP are read from the schemes' own charges (`charged.month`, `charged.year` — those schemes come first in the catalogue), and the TER already withheld from `charged.year.PPH21.employee`. PMK 168/2023 (official text, https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/download/e60a82e0-b218-40f5-9d18-b924aa1e11ce/2023pmkeuangan168.pdf): art.10(2) and the Lampiran worked examples cap biaya jabatan at Rp500,000 for each month worked in the tax year ("maksimal 4 X Rp500.000,00" for a September joiner; `person.months` from the later of 1 January, `employment.start_date` and the tax-subject start). Art.10(1)(c): zakat or a compulsory religious contribution paid through the employer is deducted (customer input `employee.facts.zakat_monthly`). Art.15(3): where the subjective tax obligation starts after January or ends before December (`terms.facts.tax_subject_from` / `tax_subject_until`, e.g. a foreigner arriving or leaving Indonesia), the net income is annualised (× 12 / months) and the tax prorated (× months / 12); the month the subject status ends is the last tax period. Art.12(2)(b), 16(2)(b) and Lampiran III.1.5(b): a daily worker above Rp2,500,000 a day is taxed at the art.17(1)(a) rates on 50% of each day's gross. Not modelled: PPh 21 DTP (PMK 10/2025, PMK 105/2025).

configuration.limitation: PMK 105/2025 (official text, jdih.kemenkeu.go.id): the PPh 21 on the whole gross of 2026 of a certain employee of an employer whose main KLU in the DJP database is in Lampiran A (133 codes: footwear, textile and garment, furniture, leather, tourism; `company.facts.klu`) is borne by the government for the tax periods January to December 2026 (arts.2–3). The employee holds an NPWP or a DJP-integrated NIK (`employee.facts.tax_id_validated`) and, if permanent, received fixed and regular gross of at most Rp10,000,000 in January 2026 or in the first month worked in 2026 (`employee.facts.pph21_dtp_reference_gross` with `pph21_dtp_reference_year`; art.4(2)); a non-permanent one at most Rp500,000 a day on average (`terms.facts.daily_wage`) or Rp10,000,000 a month when paid monthly (art.4(3) / 4(5)). Final-taxed income is excluded (severance, art.4(6)). The tax is still computed and reported on the bukti potong (art.5(3)) and paid to the employee in cash with the wage (art.5(1)): this row charges minus the month’s PPh 21, so the net is the gross before tax and the deposit (PPH21_PAYMENT) nets to nil; a December excess is not refunded (art.5(5), Lampiran B example 3), which the same minus reproduces. The cash is not taxable income (art.5(2)). The cash is due with the payment the tax is withheld from (art.5(1) “pada saat pembayaran penghasilan”), so it is never deferred: an off-cycle slip pays back its own PPh 21 at once, and each slip pays the month’s PPh 21 less the DTP the month’s earlier slips already paid (charged.month.PPH21_DTP), so no month is paid back twice. A payee (engagement PAYEE: a person paid without employment) is not charged on this scheme.

configuration.limitation: PP 68/2009 arts.2–4, 6 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP_No_68_2009.pdf): severance paid at once is subject to a final PPh 21 — 0% to Rp50,000,000, 5% to 100,000,000, 15% to 500,000,000, 25% above. Art.1 angka 4: uang pesangon includes UPMK, uang penggantian hak (leave paid on termination, travel home), uang pisah and PKWT compensation (owner ruling) — each class counts toward this row. Art.2(2): parts paid within two calendar years are one payment — this year's parts (`year` + this month, less `charged.year`) are banded on from the base charged last calendar year (`earned.history` statutory base of last year's months), so the bands continue rather than restart. Art.6: a part paid in the third calendar year or later (a severance base charged two or more calendar years back) takes the art.17(1)(a) rates on that year's parts and is not final (a creditable prepayment). `earned.history` reaches 24 calendar months back: a first part paid before then is not seen, so a warning is raised when the exit lies before last year and no part two years back is read. Residents only (art.1 angka 3); a non-resident's is PPh 26. A payee (engagement PAYEE: a person paid without employment) is not charged on this scheme.

references.title: PP 68/2009 art.2–4: severance pay (uang pesangon, uang penghargaan masa kerja) paid at once is subject to a final PPh 21 — 0% to Rp 50,000,000, 5% to 100,000,000, 15% to 500,000,000, 25% above — separately from the monthly TER withholding; the tiers accumulate over payments within two years, which this row reads as one payment. PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4 defines uang pesangon as income paid, under whatever name and in whatever form, in connection with the end of service or termination, including UPMK and UPH; uang pisah is paid only on termination (PP 35/2021 arts.50–54), so it is in this final base and outside the TER. uang kompensasi PKWT is paid when the fixed-term agreement ends (PP 35/2021 art.15(2)), in connection with the end of service, so it is in this final base too. the uang penggantian hak PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4 names includes untaken, unlapsed annual leave (PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a)), so leave cashed out on or after the last day of work (`ENCASHMENT` once `employment.exit_date` has passed) is in this final base and out of the PPH21 TER/annual base; an in-service cash-out stays ordinary income. PP 68/2009 (signed text: https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP_No_68_2009.pdf): the four uang pesangon bands are art.4 (art.5 is the two-band scale for pension benefit, THT and JHT). Art.1 angka 3 limits “Pegawai” to a resident individual, so a non-resident’s separation pay is PPh 26 at 20% of gross (PMK 168/2023 arts.5(1), 12(9), 14(1)), not this row. Art.2(2) and its elucidation (“dihitung sebagai satu kesatuan untuk pengenaan pajaknya”): payments made within two calendar years count as paid at once, so the bands run on this employer’s severance base of the previous and current calendar years (`scheme.last_year`, `scheme.year_to_date`) plus this one, less what those payments already withheld. PP 68/2009 art.6(1)–(3) and its elucidation: a part paid in the third calendar year or later, counted from the tax year of this employer’s first charged severance base (`scheme.first_year`), is not joined to the earlier parts: it is withheld at the UU PPh art.17(1)(a) rates as amended by UU 7/2021 on the gross of that calendar year’s parts (`scheme.year_to_date` plus this one), less what that year already withheld; that withholding is not final and is creditable as a prepayment in the recipient’s annual return (art.6(2)), and art.21(5a)’s 120% applies without an NPWP (art.6(3), election `no_tax_id`). Elucidation: 5% × 50,000,000 = 2,500,000, 120% of it = 3,000,000. Ceiling: the year gross is this scheme’s severance parts; other income paid in that year is withheld under PPH21 and is not added (the elucidation’s example assumes none). A new severance after an earlier one (rehire) is joined to it, and counts its third year from it. a missing tax registration does not waive withholding (`unregistered_action` ASSESS; the payslip warns that registration is outstanding). UU PPh art.21(1) puts the withholding on the payer, and art.21(5a) answers a recipient without an NPWP with a rate 20% higher, not with no tax; the declarations this scheme reads are still required.

configuration.limitation: PP 34/2021 art.1 angka 7: the DKPTKA is the compensation an employer pays for each foreign worker, non-tax state revenue or regional revenue; it is USD 100 per position per month, paid in advance for the period worked (Kemnaker tariff; secondary). Employer-only, once a month: every slip assesses it (assess_without_wage) and charges the month’s USD 100 less what the month’s earlier slips charged (charged.month.DKPTKA), so an off-cycle slip in the month does not charge it again. Exempt positions (government bodies, diplomats, and the others the tariff exempts) are recorded on the terms (`terms.facts.dkptka_exempt`). A payee (engagement PAYEE: a person paid without employment) is not charged on this scheme.
